title: Word Scramble
description: Unscramble the jumbled letters to find the hidden word before time runs out. Build a streak for bonus time and use a hint if you get stuck.
instructions: Click or tap letters in order to spell the word, or just type it.
Backspace removes the last letter. Enter checks your answer.
Press the hint button (or ?) to reveal a letter.
Each correct word adds time to the clock.
